$comment: stitchu design tokens — THE single source. web/css/tokens.css and App/Stitchu/Tokens.swift are both GENERATED from this file by scripts/gen-design-tokens.mjs. Do not hand-edit either output; edit here and regenerate. Gate: engine/tests/ios_zemin_check.mjs.

header: /* stitchu design tokens — the single source for the visual language.
RESKIN 2026-07-16 (Damla, patch 2.1): baby-blue world replaces vişne. Layout
and Didot structure unchanged; only the color world turns. Text is navy for
WCAG-AA contrast on white/pale-blue. Flat Helvetica on pattern paper. */

groups.label: thread palette (muted, never loud) — mirrors the Worker's WALL_COLORS
type — Helvetica only, weight 400 only (bold is banned)
shape — sharp corners: 2px is the house maximum

tail: html, body { background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); }
b, strong { font-weight: 400; } /* bold is banned; neutralize accidents */
.wrap { max-width: var(--measure); margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 var(--space-3); }

swift.$comment: Emitted for the iOS app so the Swift surface reads the SAME hex values as the web. Namespaced under StitchuTokens so it cannot collide with the hand-written Palette/Quicksand in App/Stitchu/Theme.swift (that file is untouched).

fontStacks.$comment: The ONLY literal font-family stacks allowed anywhere in web/css. Anything else must become a token first. Comparison is whitespace/quote/case-insensitive.

legacy.$comment: DECLARED EXCEPTIONS (ratchet, never a licence). Every literal colour still hand-written in web/css outside the generated tokens.css is listed here with the reason it has not been tokenised yet. ios_zemin_check.mjs fails on any literal NOT in this list, and on any file whose literal count rises above maxLiteralsPerFile. The numbers may only go DOWN.

colors.reason: shorthand of --paper; kept literal so the generated tokens.css stays byte-identical to the shipped file
navy hover state, no token yet (candidate --navy-hover)
dashed input/border blue in app.css, no token yet (candidate --line-input)
warm off-white used as text ON navy fills, no token yet (candidate --paper-warm)
VİŞNE LEFTOVER — the reskin missed .print-cuttable td:first-child; print-only surface
print sub-text grey, print stylesheet only
print table rule grey, print stylesheet only
print cut-table header fill, pre-reskin warm tint

api.$comment: Endpoints backend/API.md is allowed to document. ios_zemin_check.mjs cross-checks this list against backend/worker.js routing AND against the headings in API.md — a doc heading with no route, or a route documented under a name the worker does not serve, fails.

undocumented.$comment: Real routes that API.md deliberately does not publish (internal / not part of the app+API contract).
